title: Only 11% Of Adults Pass This Bible Quiz
summary: Explore First Stories, People and Promises, Words and Wisdom, The Early Church, Scripture Connections across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Know the stories and the people?
Put the pieces together.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: First Stories, People and Promises, Words and Wisdom, The Early Church, Scripture Connections. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz does not assess faith, belief or religious knowledge formally.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.
